bind_address.description: IP address to bind the HTTP server to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces)

ssl_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS using TLS; requires valid certificate and key files

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to SSL/TLS certificate file (PEM format)

ssl_key_path.description: Path to SSL/TLS private key file (PEM format)

base_url.description: Full public URL where the service is hosted (e.g., 'https://pnopaste.example.com/')

data_dir.description: Directory to store paste files (used only with 'filesystem' backend)

max_paste_size_bytes.description: Maximum allowed size (in bytes) for a single paste

default_expiration_seconds.description: Default time (in seconds) before pastes expire (0 = never expire)

syntax_highlighting.description: Enable automatic syntax highlighting for supported languages

allowed_languages_list.description: List of allowed language identifiers (e.g., ['python', 'rust', 'go']); leave empty to allow all

rate_limit_enabled.description: Enable per-IP rate limiting for paste creation

rate_limit_requests_per_minute.description: Maximum number of paste creations allowed per IP per minute

rate_limit_burst_size.description: Maximum burst size (instantaneous requests) before throttling

public_only.description: Restrict paste creation to public-only (no private/unlisted options)

admin_enabled.description: Enable admin panel (requires valid admin token)

admin_token.description: Secret token for admin access (generate a secure random string)

log_file.description: Path to log file (if empty, logs to stderr)
